dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a near-linear vertical descent with minimal concavity observed only at the posterior basal junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Morphologically rounded apex with a narrow pixel radius; lacks acute tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Extremely gradual anterior margin contour, approximately 20 to 25 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High width-to-height ratio; base width is approximately 3.5 times the maximum vertical height from the ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-colored mottled scarring and depigmented patches concentrated on the posterior half and apex of the fin; minor irregularities present on the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast white patch patterning covering roughly 30 percent of the visible dorsal fin surface.
